heading: INT. REQUISITIONED OPERA HOUSE - FIELD HEADQUARTERS - DAY

units.text: INT. REQUISITIONED OPERA HOUSE - FIELD HEADQUARTERS - DAY
Gilded boxes, a chandelier wrapped in burlap, a stage covered with maps.
Plaster cherubs peer down at a long table of officers.
Somewhere, a piano is out of tune.
MAJOR PATRICK HALLORAN, 50s, silver at the temples, stands at the center of the stage with a pointer.
CAPTAIN LUCIEN BEAUMONT, 40s, a trim moustache and a brigade tie, sits stiffly at his left.
LIEUTENANT THOMAS DUPREE, 20s, pale, writes everything down.
SERGEANT GRISWOLD, 40s, a boxer's nose, leans on a velvet curtain with arms crossed.
We hold the bridge until dawn. After that, it isn't ours.
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: He'll never hold until dawn, Major.
units.name: BEAUMONT

units.text: Which he, sir?
units.name: DUPREE

units.text: He means me.
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: I mean the man you've put at the east end.
units.name: BEAUMONT

units.text: He's mine, sir. He's the best I've got.
units.name: GRISWOLD

units.text: Then God help the rest.
units.name: BEAUMONT

units.text: The door at the back bangs open.
A scrap of daylight cuts the aisle.
PRIVATE WIGGINS, 18, a mud-streaked messenger with a satchel, runs down the carpet at full tilt and salutes, panting.
Major, sir. The bridge is gone.
units.name: WIGGINS

units.text: Silence.
A cherub's plaster smile hangs over them.
How gone?
units.name: HALLORAN

units.text: Blown, sir. From our side.
units.name: WIGGINS

units.text: Beaumont slowly stands.
Halloran lowers his pointer.
